boundary: This is a gate-level Clifford synthesis on the abstract latent C9 subsystem. It does not by itself identify laboratory controls that address that subsystem without leakage, nor does it make the subsequent Clebsch-Gordan compiler Clifford.

gauge.new_tensor_labels: |a,b>, with a selecting scalar/V/Vbar row and b the qutrit coordinate

headline: The supposedly abstract A9 commutant control has a standard two-qutrit Clifford realization. Reverse the basis order in the Vbar block and identify the 9 latent basis states with |a,b>, a,b in F3. Then the H27 generators are X_A=SUM_{a->b}, Z_A=I tensor Z, and the H27 center C_A=Z tensor I.
physical_consequence: The representation-theoretic repair of Passes 11043-11047 does not require a magic/non-Clifford gate at the latent-control stage. Conditional on access to the exact C9 multiplicity/noiseless subsystem, the needed H27 dressing is generated by a standard qutrit SUM and single-qutrit Pauli Z operations.
